title: Add concept-first guided character creation flow
description:
Implement the guided CLI flow for the canonical modern path: Concept-first — I know what I want to play.

Step order
identity/concept → class → ancestry → background → ability scores → class choices → spells/equipment → review

UX requirements
- Show the exact mode label.
- Accept list numbers, display names, common aliases, case-insensitive text, and safe unambiguous prefixes.
- Users should not need internal record IDs.
- Class and ancestry choices should resolve through the generated rules-pack resolver.
- Helper text should reflect the selected class/ancestry when data is available.

Acceptance criteria
- User can start a new character in concept-first mode.
- User can choose class and ancestry by display name or unambiguous prefix.
- Invalid class/ancestry produces actionable suggestions rather than whole-draft failure.
- Flow preserves draft state when using back/review/set where implemented.
- Transcript-style tests cover a representative successful concept-first path and common correction path.
